LiCal ist ein Kalender für Ubuntu und An: LiCal is a calendar for Ubuntu and Android, built like Apple’s Calendar. It shows day, week, month and year, reminds you of events and knows the public holidays. It needs no account and shows no ads.

LiCal looks and works like Apple’s Calendar.
On Ubuntu as on the Mac, on Android as on the iPhone. You don’t need an account.
